hash_method.serialization: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted lexicographically recursively; array order preserved; no added whitespace
hash_method.digest_scope: Full row property object returned by the saved view query, including Notion page URL; no Notion block body, comment, binary file or hidden subtree bytes

coverage.caveat: The 45 active database record pages and five container/schema assets were fetched individually. No stable Notion file-block references, nested child database references, discussion markers, unknown-block markers or truncation markers surfaced. Comment enumeration itself is entitlement-blocked (upgrade_required); external links and inaccessible/unindexed assets outside scoped SDGDS search are not checksum-covered.

recursive_read_audit.technique: Individually fetched all 45 active Notion database record pages with include_file_urls=true and include_discussions=true; separately fetched five container/schema pages.

comments_api.observation: notion_get_comments returned suggested_edits_status=upgrade_required for the root, roadmap, migration roadmap and both databases.
comments_api.conclusion: The absence of discussion markers in page fetches is not proof of zero comments. Comment enumeration is not available to this connected workspace.

attachment_scope.conclusion: No stable notion-file-block references surfaced in the 45 record pages or five container/schema pages.
attachment_scope.limitation: This does not rule out external URL links, inaccessible files, linked pages outside the search scope, hidden workspace assets or binary content not exposed by the connector.

recursive_page_scope.note: All 45 individual database record pages were fetched; no nested child database, separate child page or visible unknown/truncation marker was observed. Fetch output exposes serialized page properties/body, not a complete raw Notion block-child export or workspace-wide revision dump.
